announcement: A TASTE OF TRADITION · GOODNESS FROM BIHAR · MADE FOR EVERY HOME
metaDescription: INNIYA — traditional goodness inspired by Bihar. Discover Thekua and Indian pantry favourites.
heroText: Discover familiar flavours, thoughtful ingredients and the warmth of Indian food traditions — lovingly brought into everyday moments.
heroStampText: A little tradition in every bite.
storyTitle: From a cherished tradition to your everyday table.
storyParagraph1: INNIYA is a new food-brand concept inspired by the warmth of Bihar, the joy of sharing prasad and the simple comfort of traditional Indian flavours. Our journey begins with Thekua — with a long-term dream of bringing more regional favourites to homes across India.
storyParagraph2: We believe good food should feel familiar, be presented thoughtfully and bring people closer together.
bannerText: Build a thoughtful snack box for family, friends and festive moments.
promiseText: We’re building the brand with a simple principle: respect tradition, be clear about what’s inside and earn customer trust.
